title: Price Oracle Connect Dotnet
tagline: A set of extensions that help to use Aava's oracle and data provider and chainlink's oracles using Dotnet(c#)
description:
oracle connect is a collection of plugin that helps you to access Aave's oracle price and data provider, and chainlink's oracle price feed 

and a website brings together all these plugins and show information about the tokens 

https://github.com/lucasespinosa28/NChainlink
https://github.com/lucasespinosa28/NAave
how_its_made:
the technologies used was, Dotnet, Ens, and solidity



solidity and Nethereum were used to generate codes and read contracts. Dotnet was the platform used in these projects 



I build two plugins that help to work with Aave and Chainlink oracles and the website that use  all these plugins



I built everything myself. and I learned a lot doing it
